title: The Hungry Cat
text:
Mia has a small red bag. One day, she finds a black cat in the park. The cat is hungry and very thin.

Mia gives the cat some milk. The cat drinks it all and purrs. Mia takes the cat home to her family.

questions.text: What does Mia give the cat?
How does the cat probably feel after it drinks the milk?
Why does Mia take the cat home?

vocabulary.definition: having very little fat on the body
a white drink that comes from cows
makes a soft sound, as a cat does when it is happy

paragraph_translations: Mia tem uma bolsa pequena e vermelha. Um dia, ela encontra um gato preto no parque. O gato está com fome e é muito magro.
Mia dá um pouco de leite ao gato. O gato bebe tudo e ronrona. Mia leva o gato para casa, para a família dela.
